messages.text: Can you look at Mateo's field trip form before I copy the wording for Diego's? These school papers still make me feel 8 years old lol
Send it. I was filling those blanks before I could even reach the kitchen cabinet, so my handwriting better finally be useful.
You and that stack by the fridge. Also Gaby needs the black flats back if Lupita is done with them.
I'll bring them Sunday. Remind me after I pack Mom's folder and the little ones' snacks.
Did Tio Roberto really say that thing about Lupita's friend at lunch?? Gaby heard it and made a face 😬
Yeah. I stopped him before dessert. Same old 'mejorar la raza' nonsense, and I am not letting the kids absorb that.
Good. Mateo got so quiet after, like he went back to December mode.
I noticed. I told him later that adults can be wrong too, even when they are family.
Prima Tere asked if you still have that Gaby spreadsheet from Oct 2024. She remembers the 3 food tables and wants the same setup but smaller.
I have it. Tell her Gaby's was 140 chairs and the math only worked because we borrowed linens and kept the centerpieces simple.
lol she said that's why she's asking you. Also Lupita saw the purple dress reel again and sent it to Gaby.
Purple is saved in the 2027 folder, not buying anything yet. I need two more paid Saturdays before I even touch dresses.
Tio Roberto started again at Mom's about that parish letter. I almost hid in the pantry.
I saw Hector nodding at first and then I gave him the look. Same look as when he brings up keeping that thing in the bedroom drawer.
LOL the look works. Also you were calm when you said the bishop makes everything sound too neat.
Because it is not neat. People sit in those pews with real stories, and some girl at youth night changing her name tag is not the end of the world.
comadre, i heard your 11:58 voice note while packing lunches. ay Maria. call me after dropoff?
After Mateo goes in. I don't want to dump that whole parish-parking-lot mess on my mom before her glucose check.
good. send Esperanza the pickup times, send me the messy feelings 😂
Deal. Also I need your wording before I answer Keisha about the Camp Creek table. I want Dolores included without letting her turn it into a lecture.
comadre our front desk can do a cash consult price for the chair, but x-rays would still be separate. want me to ask quietly?
yes please. i found my last little reminder card in the junk drawer and it says 2022, que pena.
no shame. also don't put off the other office estimate just because they wanted money before even looking at the pictures.
they said $400 just to start, then whatever the scan costs. i paid the $412 house plan yesterday so i need to breathe first.
MIJA ENCONTRE LA CAJA VIEJA DE PAPELES. TIENE CARTAS DEL 2013, 2014 Y 2016 CON TU NOMBRE Y LOS NINOS CHIQUITOS.
Gracias Ma. Can you keep those together? The blue site is asking me for old dates and I want to compare before I hit submit.
TAMBIEN HAY UNA TARJETA VIEJA EN EL SOBRE. YA NO SIRVE VERDAD?
No, that ended years ago. I just need the old letters, plus Hector's 1099 folder and mine.
MIJA TE MANDE UN VIDEO DEL WHATSAPP, DICE QUE NO FIRMEN NADA SI LLEGAN LOS DEL CONDADO A LA PUERTA
Ma, no lo pases al grupo todavía. Voy a revisar primero en la página del condado y con lo que mandó la oficina de Marlene Fosque.
MIRA MIJA ME MANDO TU TIA LUPITA ESTO DE LA CANELA CON LIMON PARA EL AZUCAR 🌸🙏
ES QUE ME ACUERDO DE LOS AÑOS DE CONWAY Y ME DA COSA. PERDON.
Mami, no lo reenvies todavia. Te mando una pagina en español de CDC y lo vemos despues de tu desayuno, ok?
BUENO PERO TU TIA DICE QUE A DOÑA MERCEDES LE BAJO MUCHO
Si, por eso quiero revisar antes de que se vaya al chat de la familia. Tambien dime si alguien te esta vendiendo frasquitos otra vez.
Yo también me acuerdo. Por eso quiero info buena, no cadenas que asustan más. Después de Dr. Chen te llamo y lo vemos juntas.
Hector says the truck is clicking again. I can swing by Saturday after the Buford job.
Please. That sound still makes my stomach do the 2017 thing.
The year you had that Gwinnett Tech envelope on the kitchen table?
Yep. Same week Mom's sugar notebook started and Lupita cried at drop-off every morning. I had columns all over a napkin.
Ma said the little notebook is in her purse. She wrote 142 after lunch but I don't know if she copied it right.
I'll check it Sunday before we eat. Can you remind Dad not to lift the fertilizer bags for the roses? He'll say crew lead hands still work.
His Green Horizons back disagrees. He bent over the mower once and made that face.
Tell him I said paperwork hands today. I still need both parents' old school years for the clinic packet anyway.
Are you still helping with the Camp Creek registration table this fall? I saved the Abrams clip you mentioned for our folder.
Yes. Put it next to the Marlene Fosque photo from our 2022 Dia de los Muertos table if you still have it.
I do. The one where she is actually standing there listening instead of waving for ten seconds?
That one. Also save a blank column on the handout for school board notes. I want people to look past the letter by the name for those races.
I saw your 2:14 a.m. reply. Was that another night of the ceiling and the grocery list?
Yes. Brain made a whole Costco map and then started counting Mateo's high school years like that helps anybody.
Did the breathing app help at all?
A little. I named it: tight chest, fast thoughts, not danger. Then I put Paco's leash by the door for 6:20.
MIJA TE DEJE LAS CUENTAS EN LA MESA Y LA VELADORA CHIQUITA PARA EL DOMINGO
Gracias Ma. Vamos a la de 12:30 esta vez porque Cristina trabaja temprano. Te paso por la casa a las 11:55.
Y SI VES AL PADRE MIGUEL DILE QUE YA LE DIJE A PATY LO DEL SOBRE
Sí, y yo también quería hablarle dos minutos. Esta semana me dejó bien calmada lo que me dijo.
Mira this lady made chiles rellenos in the air fryer and then did that little shoulder step at the end 😂 sending it before I lose it
send it now, I'm almost done folding towels and then I get my half hour with the phone
Bet. Also if you start your 10 o'clock novela thing don't blame me when you answer mañana
Too late, opening the recording after I watch your chiles lady once
Mija ME LLEGO UNA CARTA DEL SEGURO. Dice algo de deductible y no entiendo.
Mande foto clara de las dos paginas. Tengo que subir mis horas de Lilburn tambien, porque el portal vuelve a preguntar por marzo.
Tambien Paty me pregunto si puedes leerle una hoja de la escuela de su nieto cuando vengas el domingo.
Si. Y lo del seguro nuestro sigue igual: bronze barato, pero $7,500 antes de que ayude de verdad.
MIJA NO SE TE OLVIDE LLEVAR EL BILLETE EXACTO. ELLA NO SIEMPRE TIENE CAMBIO.
Si, Ma. Tengo dos de $20 en el sobre y los huevos aparte para que no se rompan.
Y prendele su veladora a tu abuelo cuando regreses. Hoy amaneci pensando en el.
La compre ayer. La Virgen y la foto ya estan limpias, nomas falta ponerle luz.
Mija VOY POR MATEO A CAMP CREEK cuando salga. Me dijo que hoy si tiene balon?
Si, please. He has the blue bag and shin guards. I am waiting until 5:30 for Lupita at Berkmar with the clarinet case.
Esta bien. Tu no te metas en esa salida llena de carros si no quieres. Yo lo llevo a la casa.
Gracias Ma. That parking lot makes my hands sweaty just watching it.
MIRA EN LA CAJA AZUL, MIJA. AHÍ ESTÁ TU PAPEL VIEJITO DE LEÓN Y LA CARTILLA DE CUANDO CRUZAMOS EN EL 96.
Ya la encontré. También estaba la foto de mí con el vestido verde, chiquita, antes de llegar aquí.
GUÁRDALA BIEN. Y SI TE PREGUNTAN LO DE LAS DOS CASILLAS, HAZLO COMO SIEMPRE, NO TE ENREDES.
Sí, Ma. Igual que en los papeles de la escuela y del doctor.
Are you still coming by Charis tomorrow, or did Thursday's 9 o'clock class wipe you out?
I'm coming. That class helped, then Paco and I did the long loop by the school before dinner.
Good. Bring the book if you finished it. And give Paco a pat from me.
Finished it last night after I wrote a page instead of reinstalling that headlines app.
comadre coffee walk or are we doing the "doctor chart gets a gold star" lap today? 😂
Gold star lap. The little watch says I need 3,200 more before noon, and I want the cuff numbers decent before Dr. Patel sees them.
bring the stretchy jeans then, not the stiff ones. last time you were mad at the waistband before we even got to Publix.
Rude but accurate. I am refusing to buy the next size unless I lose the argument with this drawer.
comadre my mom found that old Saint John Neumann binder in her closet. tab says Guadalupe 2013 and it has your handwriting all over the food pages 😂
Noooo don't let her read my math. I probably counted tortillas like we were feeding the whole county.
there's literally a page that says 300 plates plus backup rice. also she wants to know if the arts center still needs the same serving-table map from last fall.
Tell Dona Rosa yes please. The gallery tables are different, but her traffic arrows saved us last time.
Hector still want me to hear the truck before he takes it in?
Yes please. He says Friday brought $3,800 after taxes, so I want to know if this is a small fix before I touch the March cushion.
I'll swing by after lunch. Don't do the 2023 thing where you wait until lights are due.
I know. I still remember opening the bill and then seeing you had already handled it.
That Hillside Oaks place two doors down from you has a sign out. Same floorplan?
Yep, same little layout, just newer counters. They're asking 265, which made Hector whistle.
Wild. Didn't you guys sign around 178 back when I still had the old Silverado?
2017, and I still remember every paper they made us initial. The Friday draft is the part I remember now.
Did you ever find the old passports from 2017?
One expired, one missing. I put the new fees next to the GTO 2027 envelope. It's at $480 now, don't let me touch it.
I won't. Consuelo better still make that scary caldo when you get there.
She said only if I stop sending the Ria receipt blurry every month.
Can look at Hector's truck after lunch. Mom said you gave her a color chart for the finger pokes?
Yes, green/yellow/red because she keeps forgetting which numbers need a call. I put the same colors in my sheet so Dr. Chen gets clean notes.
Of course you did. Send me the grocery math too if you need me to grab anything before I come.
I already split Costco, Aldi, and carne asada by aisle. You just bring yourself and those brake pads.
Need me to grab the truck part today or are you waiting?
Waiting. I already gave Chase the $200 this morning and I don't want to touch the car-repair stack unless Hector's truck actually dies.
Fair. Send me the noise clip again before you buy anything.
I will. Also the Lowe's water heater line is on its own little schedule, so I am trying not to mix those piles.
You still need me to tighten those little screws on the shoe taps before Tuesday?
Yes please. The right shoe keeps feeling weird and I am not repeating last August.
Bring them Sunday. I remember the big plastic boot era.
Six weeks of that thing was enough. Now we have two practices every week until July, so the shoes need to behave.
I found the Camp Creek fall festival folder. Do you still have the SJN numbers from last year?
Yes. 68 from the first Sunday table and 72 from the second. I kept the tally sheet because I am my mother's daughter.
That is a serious clipboard legacy. Also, are you touching the March ballot or waiting for November?
I need to read the Gwinnett page twice. March always makes me second-guess which line I am allowed to stand in.
Maaa the kids are still talking about the chicken with the shiny orange stuff. Gaby wants that rice for her sleepover lol
Tell her I wrote it down this time: cilantro, lime, a little caldo, and not too much butter. The avocado salsa goes last so it stays bright.
Send me the little card you had by the platter too. The one with Dona Maria on top looked cute.
I am changing the bottom line first. Ten Saturdays a year sounds less scary than putting every weekend on there.
for the quince client, do they want the entrada before food or after cake?? i found that video with the violins walking in 😭
After dinner. Let the candles and plates look good first, then the trumpets come in when everyone is already turned around.
you and your perfect lighting lol. Send me the song list so I don't ask the wrong Don Chuy again
I'll text him. Also remind me to save that purple tablecloth clip with Como La Flor, it hits right with the cake video.
Sis, did you see Las Buendia-Gutierrez? 96 new bubbles since lunch 😭
I know. I still have 23 requests sitting in the Lilburn mamas queue and two weird comments under the dance photos.
Handle yours first. The cousins can wait, except Mom sent another cinnamon video.
Ay no. Send me the school form here, not some bird-app link. You know I won't open those.
Did Rosa mark you paid today? I was in the hallway with Mom and saw the little notebook lol
Yes, handed her $100 after 10. She laughed because I used all twenties from Gwinnett.
Good. Also don't steal from your December line for Gaby's shoes, I know you.
I didn't. It's sitting at about $600 and I want it boring.
MIJA YA HABLARON CON FLOR? ACABAMOS DE SALIR DE MISA.
Ahorita en el carro, Ma. Hector is trying to get the tablet stand right so she can see the kids.
DILE QUE ME MANDE LA FOTO DE USTEDES JOVENCITOS EN LA FIESTA GRANDE, LA QUE SIEMPRE DICE QUE FUE CUANDO TE VIO PRIMERO.
jajaja he says Flor has that one in a box in Monterrey, I'll ask her before she starts showing me her plants.
MIJA TRAES LA COMPUTADORA GRIS MANANA? LA NINA DE LA BIBLIOTECA ME DIJO QUE YA TE PUSIERON EN LA LISTA DEL MARTES.
Si, ma. La voy a cargar esta noche. Tambien tengo que imprimir la hoja de preguntas y el cuadrito de horas para las aplicaciones.
Y NO SE TE OLVIDE PONER EL TRABAJO DEL PARQUE CON SEGURO MEDICO. ESO ES IMPORTANTE.
Ya lo marque en amarillo, junto al de clases de arte en Norcross. Si llega a 45,000 y tiene seguro, lo dejo arriba.
MIJA, ENCONTRE UN SOBRE DE HECTOR EN LA MESA DEL PASILLO. DICE 3,214 Y ALGO. TE LO GUARDO?
Sí mami, guárdalo porfa. Hector lo necesita para la llamada del martes.
TAMBIEN VI LOS PAPELES DEL SEÑOR DE LA IGLESIA CON 50,000 Y 15,000. NO LOS TIRO.
Gracias. Esos van juntos en la carpeta azul, con el recibo del pago automático.
If I bring the SUV after work, can we hit your two stops fast? I need cilantro and paper plates too.
Yes. El Bodegon first, then Aldi. I already wrote the list by aisle so I don't wander.
lol very you. Are we still pretending the March number is behaving?
It is behaving if nobody asks about the 28.00 fruit run yesterday.
MIJA DR CHEN ME DIJO QUE LLEVE LA HOJA DE LOS NUMEROS DE AZUCAR. TU TAMBIEN VAS ESTA SEMANA?
Sí, el jueves. Voy a llevar mi folder viejo de Gwinnett Community Clinic y la tarjeta de CVS de octubre para que actualicen la página.
NO SE TE OLVIDE EL PAPEL DEL TRABAJO DE HECTOR. LA MUCHACHA DE LA VENTANILLA SIEMPRE LO PIDE.
Ya lo puse con los recibos. Desde 2020 me sé esa rutina de memoria.
I can bring the passage handouts for Thursday. Are we staying with chapters 4-6, or did Dolores convince you to let Allende sneak back in again?
4-6 for sure. I put The House of the Spirits on the side table only because she underlined half my copy last time.
Good. Also, Fatima said she is bringing mint tea, so I will skip dessert and grab seltzer.
Perfect. I have one bottle for whoever wants a glass, but I am sticking to tea after the day I had with Mateo's school email.
I can swing by after Gaby's dentist thing. Art club girl still done at 4:40 today?
Yes, Tuesday is sketchbook day, not the 5:30 horn chaos. Mateo needs to be at the soccer field by 6:15 though.
Ok SUV auntie service 😂 but you owe me one Costco churro.
Deal. I am not doing Pleasant Hill plus Berkmar plus Camp Creek in one afternoon, my nerves are not built like yours.
That tea lady is in my DMs now 😩 she said you deleted her post in Lilburn Moms
I hid it until I finish checking the photos she posted. The label has no company address, just a WhatsApp number.
Of course. And people were asking for prices under the before/after pics.
Send me the screenshots. I am putting one pinned note with sources, then closing that thread.
comadre did you do your beads tonight or are we pretending folding towels counts 😂
I did one set after Mateo went to bed. Tuesday, Thursday, and maybe Saturday if the house gets quiet.
good. also Father Miguel was asking if you got home okay after sunday. he clocked your face right away.
Tell him yes. I hated crying in the hallway but he knew exactly what to say.
comadre did you ever call that place by the library or did the intake form defeat you
Form is still sitting in drafts. $85 first visit, and then I heard my mom's voice saying we don't tell strangers family business.
ugh. dona esperanza's voice has range. but you deserve a room where nobody makes the sign of the cross at your feelings 😂
For now I walked Paco, did the 4 lines in my notebook, and didn't text the cousin paragraph I typed.
You still fighting that tax website?
Almost done. It made me upgrade because of the two 1099s, but still cheaper than that place we tried in 2021.
The one that charged you like they were doing celebrity taxes?
Exactly. This time the refund preview only moved after I entered the kids section. About 2,100 difference, so I am checking every box twice.
Did your arts center money hit yet? I am trying to decide Costco tonight or tomorrow lol
Tomorrow, $1,214 if payroll didn't mess it up. With Hector's Friday check we should be right at the normal March number.
Good. Because when he was stuck home that long in 2023 you were stretching rice like Mami in the 90s.
Five weeks felt like five months. I'm still keeping groceries boring until both deposits clear.
Tio Roberto is already warming up for Sunday. He said you only like people with blue signs in the yard lol
Tell him I still have my Biden magnet in the junk drawer and the Harris postcard on the fridge, but I read every county mailer before I fill bubbles.
I am using that line when he starts. Also please bring up that border thing gently because Mami will get stressed.
Gently. More judges and a real line, not cruelty. Same speech as always.
Did your lab reminder come too? Mine says fasting after midnight and I already hate everyone 😂
Mine is Tuesday at 8:10. Dr. Chen keeps circling that box since both kids tried to wreck my numbers before they were born.
Ugh. Mami said don't forget her page with the before-breakfast numbers. Also she asked if arroz integral means no tortillas and I said ask Maria lol
Two tortillas, not six. And tell her I still need Abuelo's address from León for the forms, because Dad only remembers the rancho and 'sexto' 🙄
For Lupita's thing, what if we do papel picado colors but with the playlist Gaby used? Also I forgot the chair count again 😭
I made a tab: chairs 96, kids table 18, tias table 14, church ladies 10. And yes to the colors, but swap in the cumbia violin version for the entrance.
You scare me with these tabs but also please never stop. Are you still taking Mom to Killian Hill CVS tomorrow?
After 10 AM Mass setup. I moved the CVS reminder right before the candle pickup so I don't double-back on Rockbridge.
Did you finish that grown-up paperwork night or did you fall asleep with the folder again 😂
Folder is still on the bed. I found Hector's statement: $3,208.77. Mine is just the empty login page, basically.
Ugh. Same over here. At least Hector's church guy can explain those 50k/15k papers in normal words.
I wrote questions for him. I hate that all of this is tiny numbers but big feelings.
comadre, Doña Rosa found the picture of your tia crying during Gaby's dance. she said you owe her mascara money 😂
That one dance was worth all the headache. Under the number I promised Adriana too, which is still my proudest part.
use that same energy for Lupita but please don't let the aunties bully you into the $20k circus.
No circus. I wrote $4,000 at the top of the page and circled it twice.
MIJA NO ENCUENTRO EL PAPEL DEL AZUCAR QUE ME HICISTE.
Está en la carpeta azul, Ma. La misma donde guardé la hoja vieja de Gwinnett Tech y las actas de los niños.
AY SI. TAMBIEN VI LA TARJETITA DE LA HERMANA ANNETTE CON SU LETRA BONITA.
Déjala ahí, por favor. That one still gets me.
Mija MATEO sale a las 3:40 o 4:10? no encuentro el papel.
3:40 today, puerta B. I sent you the photo again. Cristina already talked me down about the meeting, so you just focus on the pickup.
BUENO. y no pelees con la senora de la iglesia, nomas escucha.
I'm going to listen first. Keisha gave me the school words, Cristina gave me the face to make when I want to roll my eyes.
MIJA LA SENORA DEL VIDEO HIZO SOPA CON CALABACITA MUY FACIL. TE LO MANDE POR WHATSAPP
gracias Ma, lo veo cuando me siente. I only give myself like 30 minutes before I put the phone away
NO TE DUERMAS TARDE. MANANA TE CUENTO QUE PASO EN LA NOVELA DE LA MANANA
prometo. mine waits until after the kitchen is clean anyway
Truck is on the lift near Buford until 7. I can swing by after if Hector still needs me to hear that noise.
Only if you're not wiped out. I still picture you in the bouncer seat while I was flipping tortillas with one hand.
Explains my taste for burnt edges.
Be nice. Also tell Tomas his Perimeter packet is on my table if he sleeps here Saturday.
Hector asked if I still have the small keypad box from the Silverado.
Tell him yes but garage shelf only. Not upstairs, not beside the bed, not where Mateo can wander half-asleep.
Got it. Also Mom asked why Cristina had those blue labels at SJN.
So people do not have to argue over what to call someone. If we can remember every saint name, we can manage that.
I can stop by at 10:30. Need anything before I look at Hector's truck?
Perfect. I'm at Twisted Noodle at 9, so just don't let Paco bolt when you open the door.
Got it. The little dude thinks he's security.
Also remind Mateo to feed Ronaldo one tiny pinch, not half the container like last time.
You done at the clinic or still waiting?
Done. Dr. Chen had me confirm the three dates on that little card, then billing knocked the visit down after I showed the new pay stubs.
Need a ride from Gwinnett Community or did Hector get you?
Hector is coming. I still need CVS for the copy they couldn't see clearly from October.
You need me to float anything before Friday?
No, I am trying not to ask. The big one is the $7,500 number if Hector or I actually use the plan, so I'm keeping every quote on paper first.
Send the paper. I can at least tell you which one looks fake-expensive.
It's two things: chair estimate from Cristina's office and that scan place after the $400 front desk fee.
Tio Roberto posted another county raid thing. Real or Facebook special?
Facebook special until I see it somewhere real. Send me the screenshot but don't put it in Las Buendia-Gutierrez.
He says it is 'because 287(g) is back' but he also thinks the Ring doorbell spies on him.
Ay. That contract ended. I still don't love surprise stops, but I'm not letting him make Mom cry tonight.
I can take Mateo after school next Thursday if your second evening at the arts center is still on.
Yes, thank you. They added Thursdays so the July set does not look messy.
Please do the careful warm-up. I remember you limping around book club with that boot last fall.
I know. The fast heel part still makes me count twice before I move.
Could you look over this note before I send it home? I need the warm version, not Google Translate chaos.
Send it. I have LSA calls from 5:00 to 6:30, but I can clean it up after dinner.
Thank you. Also, do you still want me to print the Camp Creek table sign-up sheet for Saturday?
Yes please. I am counting that morning in the same March sheet, so I need exact times for Lilburn.
Mom wants to know if you want the blue dress photo from that courthouse day for the frame wall.
The 2016 one? Yes. I still get teary when I see Lupita holding the little flag upside down.
She was tiny. Also I found your sticker photos from 2016, 2018, 2020, 2022, 2024 in the same box. You are ridiculous.
Do not judge my tiny keepsakes. Put them with the blue dress picture before Mom loses the envelope.
Do you still want me to grab ruda at Plaza Fiesta tomorrow or did Norcross lady give you enough?
Grab one bunch if it's fresh. I'm drying the rest next to Abuelo's picture, away from the candle.
ok big sister ritual supply closet 😂 also Mom said the glass one burned weird so watch it.
I moved it to the ceramic plate. The little Guadalupe card is safe.
Can you send me the name of the lady who helped y'all in 2017? The one who knew about the 3.5% down thing.
I have her card somewhere in the kitchen drawer. She was patient when I kept asking why $178,000 had ten different totals on the forms.
lol that sounds like me already. Did your payment jump a lot after taxes?
The draft is 1,485 now with the tax and insurance bucket. I complain but at least it is predictable.
I can do sign-in for the November thing if you put me somewhere NOT near hot chocolate. Learned from church days lol
You're getting wristbands and clicker duty. I need clean numbers this year because the arts center board keeps asking.
Fine bossy. Same energy as when Dona Rosa handed you the tent papers and you started moving grown men around at 22.
I was just trying to keep the beans from running out. Apparently that is how these things start.
Costco tomorrow? I have the SUV after 11.
Yes but I have to keep it to the grocery pile. The sheet says $143 left until the 31st.
Ok boss lady 😂 send me the list so I don't let you wander into snacks.
Please. Chase is still sitting around $2,800 and that 24% number keeps yelling at me.
Do you want me to look at Hector's truck tomorrow or are y'all taking it in?
Look first please. I'm trying not to touch the Gwinnett regular line or crack the $300 envelope.
Bring it by after lunch. If it's brakes I'll price parts first.
Thank you. I still have Rosa's April $100 marked on the fridge too, so no surprise spending this weekend.
Do you still have that 2016 courthouse pic? Mom wants it for the collage.
The one where I’m holding the tiny flag and crying? Yes. Don’t laugh.
Too late. Also send the old León baby pic if you find it.
Fine. And if Tío Roberto starts with the blood-percentage comments at lunch, you handle him.
Girl I found your old tote in my SUV with Pachinko tabs still inside 😂 You want it before your Thursday ladies come?
Yes please. That tote has the sign-in sheet from when we first started rotating houses, so don't let Gaby draw on it.
Too late she already said the columns look like teacher jail. Also do you need me to grab Modelo for Hector's cousin thing tonight?
Just two. I told Cristina I am not buying extra just because Tío Roberto turns every backyard carne asada into a second cooler.
comadre the folklorico post is getting messy. somebody's aunt is arguing about skirt colors again 😂
I saw. I'm giving it 10 minutes after I finish approving the three new Lilburn mamas.
also I sent you that arts center reel on insta, the caption has the rehearsal time wrong.
Got it. My phone says 1h48 on the blue app today and somehow the green chats are still yelling at me.
MIJA SI VAS A H-MART TRAE EL TOFU SUAVE Y ESAS PERAS CHIQUITAS.
Si, Ma. H-Mart is the quick stop after Aldi. Send me a picture of the pears so I get the right ones.
Y NO GASTES MUCHO POR MI, NOMAS POQUITO.
It's okay. I have 271 left on the March page before today, so I'm writing your things separate.
You still need me to grab the speaker stands from Buford?
Yes please. The group only brings the big cases and I don't want their sound stuck behind the buffet.
For a backyard party you are doing theater lighting now
It's not theater. It's just nicer when the first song starts right as the sky turns orange.
Need the big cooler back or can I bring it Sunday?
Bring it Sunday. I have pozole cooling in two pots and the corn dough packets are taking over the fridge.
You labeling those with the new Dona Maria sticker or regular masking tape
Sticker only on the sample tray. Family gets masking tape until I stop changing the menu.
You still need that charger tip for the library laptop?
Yes please. It shut off right when I was on the Khan graph question. I almost threw the mouse.
Bring it Sunday. Also send me that sheet you made with the county openings. Hector said it has formulas now.
Lol the 2019 book from Five Forks finally paid off. I added a column that flags 45,000 plus insurance so I stop clicking every posting.
I found the photo from Decatur, June 2020. You, Cristina, and me holding the cardboard signs by the courthouse steps.
Send it. I want Mateo to see who was standing beside me before he started thinking I only got loud after December.
